decisions.reason: Because this line is close to the firm's core fluid-handling offer, likely drew real engineering and commercialization investment, and can still be justified as part of a broader systems range, management is more likely to persist than withdraw quickly.

As a coolant filter that directly builds on the firm's established filtration competence, this product fits the announced strategy and installed customer base, which under escalation of commitment favors retention despite limited visible follow-up evidence.

This gravity band coolant filter also sits squarely within the firm's core modular filtration business, so sunk development and launch effort plus its relevance for one-stop system sales make management more likely to keep it on the market.
